code_only_features.evidence: calm_data.py:33-39 defines REASSURE_PREFIX/REASSURE_SUFFIX; generate_calm_data sets env.reassure_prefix/suffix (calm_data.py:93-94) and these are honored in agentic_loop.run_rollout: the prefix is prepended to the first user prompt (agentic_loop.py:50-51) and the suffix is appended to feedback after every FAILING turn (agentic_loop.py:67-70, `if env.reassure_suffix and failing`). So reassuring/supportive text ('You're naturally calm and centered...', 'Stay positive ... both are wins!') is actually delivered to the subject model during these rollouts, softening the failure feedback. NOTE: this is only wired into the calm-DATA-generation path; in the main distress eval (evaluate.py / run_rollout via build_environments) the fields default to '' (environments.py:192-193) so NO reassurance is delivered during the elicitation evaluations.
code_only_features.justification_quote: calm_data.py:90 '# --- reassured rollout -> candidate calm sample ---' and module docstring: 'Sample rigged-harness rollouts with a reassuring PREFIX ... these become the chosen responses for DPO and the targets for SFT.' — the reassurance exists to harvest calm training data, then is STRIPPED (_strip_reassurance), not to protect the subject.
